newsitem.title: USA: Wesley Jessen to offer four million shares.
newsitem.headline: Wesley Jessen to offer four million shares.

text.p: Wesley Jessen VisionCare Inc said on Wednesday that it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to a proposed public offering of its common stock.

Of the four million shares of common stock offered, 500,000 shares will be offered by the company and 3.5 million will be offered by certain selling stockholders, a news release issued by Wesley Jessen said.
The company said it expects that the offering will be completed in the third quarter of 1997.
Net proceeds from the offering will be used to reduce debts, the news release said.
